title: Oracle DBA Administration Oracle DBA Administration
description:
Senior/Lead Oracle Database Administrator

REQUIREMENT SUMMARY

The Senior Oracle Database Administrator plays a critical role in managing and optimizing Oracle databases within a BFSI sector environment. This position requires a seasoned professional with a deep understanding of database architecture and performance tuning to ensure seamless operations and data integrity.

Description

- Minimum 9 years of experience in Oracle Database Administration, with expertise in Oracle RAC, RMAN, and Data Guard.

- Proven capability in managing large-scale enterprise Oracle databases and providing 24/7 production support in BFSI sector.

- Strong experience in performance tuning and optimization of Oracle databases, including use of OEM and other Oracle tools.

- Proficiency in database installation, configuration, upgrade, patching, and troubleshooting in both Linux/Unix environments.

- Experience with Oracle GoldenGate for data replication and ensuring data consistency across distributed databases.

- Familiarity with cloud database solutions, including AWS RDS, EC2, and S3, and cloud migration strategies.

- Strong problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills, with experience in leading DBA teams and coordinating across technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage Oracle databases across production, development, and test environments, ensuring high availability and reliability.

- Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and troubleshoot Oracle databases to maintain optimal performance and security.

- Provide 24/7 production support, managing incidents, performing root-cause analysis, and resolving critical database issues.

- Conduct performance tuning using AWR, ASH, SQL tuning, and execution-plan analysis to enhance database efficiency.

- Design and maintain Oracle RAC environments for high availability, ensuring seamless operations during failovers and switchover events.

- Configure and support Oracle Data Guard environments for disaster recovery, including regular DR drills and switchover tests.

- Perform database back-up and recovery operations using RMAN, ensuring data integrity and compliance with recovery objectives.

- Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and provide tailored database solutions, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Work Model & Flexibility:

· Candidates must be open to working in shift schedules, including US hours.

Interview Process:

· Screening-Welocity Octo AI Interview

· 1st Round: Virtual Technical interview with Project Team

· 2nd Round: Virtual

· Additional Requirement:

· Excellent communication skills

**Notice**
-15days to Officially 30 Days.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Seeking a skilled Core Oracle DBA – L3 with strong hands-on experience in Oracle RAC, Data Guard, and ASM. The ideal candidate should have worked in Banking or Financial Services environments, managing mission-critical production databases with high availability and performance requirements. Exposure to Exadata is an added advantage. Key Responsibilities • Manage, monitor, and maintain Oracle databases in production and non-production environments. • Provide L2 support for database incidents, performance issues, and service requests. • Administer and support: o Oracle RAC (Real Application Clusters) o Oracle Data Guard (Physical/Logical Standby setup and monitoring) o Oracle ASM (Storage management and troubleshooting) • Perform database installation, configuration, patching, and upgrades. • Implement backup and recovery strategies using RMAN. • Monitor database performance and perform tuning (SQL tuning, AWR/ASH analysis). • Handle database cloning, refresh activities, and migration tasks. • Participate in DR drills and ensure high availability configurations. • Work closely with application, infrastructure, and network teams during incident management and deployments. • Maintain documentation for configurations, SOPs, and operational procedures. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

Desired Skill:

• 8-10 years of experience as an Oracle DBA in enterprise environments. • Strong hands-on experience in: o Oracle RAC o Oracle Data Guard o Oracle ASM • Good knowledge of RMAN backup and recovery strategies. • Experience in database performance tuning and troubleshooting. • Experience working in Banking or Financial Services domain (preferred). • Knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems. • Understanding of high availability and disaster recovery concepts.
